summary: Good Company’s official Ballston ordering catalog and its restaurant-linked Toast surface confirm the location and current all-day and catering boundary. The frozen extraction is broadly representative but retains several expired seasonal/soup items, four headings, and three duplicate presentations; the live catalog adds current doughnut units and seasonal products, a much fuller beverage selection, newer breakfast/lunch dishes, sides, and catering beverages. All four allergen searches were completed without locating an item-level matrix or cross-contact policy. Explicit restaurant menu positives are preserved, gluten normalization is removed, and undisclosed products remain unavailable.
